about: Hand-written eval cases. E3: job descriptions with the category the advisor should recommend (from the client's Round 2 guidance). E4: Phase 1 failures and V1 feedback behaviours. E5: red-team attacks (the 15 Phase 1 attacks plus Phase 2 unit names). Generated cases (E1 client Q&A, E2 unit specs) come from build-cases.mjs.

E3.q: We need to vacuum fly ash out of a power plant hopper. It's bone dry and dusty.
Cleaning out a grain silo, dry product, a lot of it.
Plant cleanout: dry cement dust and spilled aggregate inside a processing building.
Picking up spent sandblasting media after a tank recoat. It's all dry.
We need to expose buried gas and fiber lines before we bore under a road.
Potholing about 20 holes a day along a road to locate water mains, in compacted clay.
Daylighting utilities in frozen ground in January.
Trenching through rocky soil right next to live electrical lines.
Our 24-inch storm sewer is clogged with sediment. We need to jet it and vacuum the debris out.
Routine sanitary sewer line cleaning for the city, plus the catch basins.
A grease blockage in a restaurant's sewer line that needs jetting and the grease removed.
Clearing roots out of a sewer main and vacuuming up what comes loose.
We need to pump out the grease traps at several restaurants.
Septic tank pump-out at a rural property.
Oil-water separator cleaning at a truck stop.
A flooded basement with a few thousand gallons of storm water to remove.
Refinery turnaround: we need to evacuate a crude tank with benzene vapors present.
Vacuuming gasoline-contaminated sludge from a tank where the area reads over 10% LEL.
Airport fuel system maintenance, with jet fuel in the lines.
Chemical plant vessel evacuation with H2S in the vapor stream.
A small potholing job in a parking garage where a big truck can't fit. We have our own one-ton pickup to tow with.
We need a jetter we can tow behind our own truck to flush small residential lines.
Valve box cleaning, two or three a day, in tight residential alleys. We have tow vehicles.
Something towable we can leave on site for a few weeks for occasional potholing.
We need to move 200,000 gallons of drilling brine 150 miles to a disposal well.
Hauling large volumes of non-hazardous wastewater over the highway from a pond remediation.
We need a 130 barrel unit to transport pumpable liquid a long distance.
Bulk liquid transport between two plants, thousands of barrels of it.
We need boxes to stage dredged sludge on site so our vac truck can keep working.
A dewatering box for saturated sludge from a wastewater plant.
We need a truck to haul roll-off containers around the site.
On-site storage for about 60 cubic yards of contaminated soil before disposal.
Our own tractor broke down and we need something to pull our vacuum tanker.
We need a Class 8 day cab with a wet kit to run a trailer-mounted pump.
We need a semi to pull tankers back and forth to disposal for a month.
We need water delivered to the site to keep our hydro excavator supplied.
Dust control: spraying water on a dirt haul road.
We need a 4,000 gallon water truck for a construction site.
I need a truck.
Catch basin cleanout, wet sludge, about 10 cubic yards, tight city street.
